_about: OBJECT CATALOGUE for the light proxies (docs/LIGHT_PROXY_PLAN.md 'Object catalogue'): our own data, block ids only, nothing from the ROM.
Rooms are built from 16 x 16 graphics blocks; the blockset belongs to the TILESET (room table byte 4 & $1F), so a recurring object (bush, pine) uses the same
layer A block ids in every room of a tileset. A cell whose TOP is drawn by one of these blocks (block (x - h, y - h), the highest cell of the view diagonal)
gets the class shape; groups of equal class stand on the most common height around them. Small free standing objects keep their sprite lathe.
Read by tools/patch_lights.py at build time. Find / check blocks: tools/blockcat.py ROM stats TILESET, sheet TILESET OUT.png, cells ROOM.
classes: shape sphere (bush: top = the cell's game height, at least base + 16, radius r) / cone (pine: base + 4 .. max(cell height, base + h), radius r).
Not listed on purpose: tileset 17 $064 = the back edge of a bush block overhanging the ground behind it (not a bush of its own).
